_note: v2.5 plan 05 F7 measurement M7 (A13 token estimate), measurement only. Needs no story or chat state: it asks the product's own request budget (storyOrchestratorLiveSuite.measureBudget: requestBudgetFor('read'), the ST main-API tokenizer meter and the read role's profile context limit) for the estimate of a synthetic prompt at about 2k/20k/80k tokens (override with localStorage 'so-v25-f7-sizes'), sends that exact prompt through the same Connection Manager call shape the product uses (messages array, includePreset/includeInstruct, extractData false, 8 tokens) and reads the server's own prompt count (llama.cpp tokens_evaluated, OAI-style usage.prompt_tokens, or timings.prompt_n; ST forwards the backend JSON unchanged: text-completions.js:409-421, chat-completions.js:2695-2699). A size above the context limit minus 512 is skipped with its reason. Records per row: estimate, actual, errorPct ((estimate - actual) / actual), overrun of contextLimit - 512. Floor (predeclared, plan 05 F7): reopen when |error| > 5 % on any size or any true overrun; the fixture records and does not fail on it (the verdict is read from the last step's 'reopen'). Two pairings per profile route: run once with the lane's main API on Text Completion, then with the main API on a Chat Completion profile (the tokenizer follows the main API, 03-H11), extraction profile unchanged; the record carries mainApi/tokenizer so the two runs cannot be confused. Capture a run header around each run.

requires.why: reads the server's own prompt count of a real Connection Manager request
